configurationFields.label: Auth Token
configurationFields.description: Sets the [auth token](https://alderongames.com/oauth/hosting-token) to install and run the server. The associated account must have access to the game

configurationFields.label: Server GUID
configurationFields.description: Sets the required GUID for the server. Must be in UUIDv4 format. Default is a random GUID

configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the public name of the server. To include spaces in the name displayed in the server list, you MUST use underscores to represent those spaces

configurationFields.label: Server Rules
configurationFields.description: Sets the server rules displayed and that must be accepted when players first join the server. Refer to these [formatting instructions](https://hosting.pathoftitans.wiki/setup/server-rules#formatting)
configurationFields.default:
<title>Server Rules</>
<red>1 - Please only attack Camptos.</>
Camptosauruses are very evil!

<orange>2 - Corpse Cove is closed due to dirty water.</>

These are the only rules on this server!
<large>Thanks, and have fun!</>

configurationFields.label: Welcome Message
configurationFields.description: Sets the welcome message displayed when players join the server. Refer to these [formatting instructions](https://hosting.pathoftitans.wiki/setup/motd#formatting)
configurationFields.default:
<title>Welcome to Path of Titans Server - GSCS!</>
<large>Have fun!</>

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password to connect to the server

configurationFields.label: RCON-Passwort
configurationFields.description: See the Security and Privacy menu for configurable options for the server's RCON

configurationFields.label: Enable BattlEye Anti-Cheat
configurationFields.description: If set, enables BattlEye Anti-Cheat

configurationFields.label: Server Map
configurationFields.description: Sets the map for the server. If using a modded map, select Custom and set the "Custom Map Name"

configurationFields.label: Custom Map Name
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom map for the server. Custom type must be selected under "Server Map". GameUserSettings.ini also needs to be configured. Refer to these [instructions](https://hosting.pathoftitans.wiki/setup/mods)

configurationFields.label: Enable Full Map
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the full map for the entire server

configurationFields.label: Enable Minimap
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the minimap for the entire server

configurationFields.label: Server/RCON IP Binding
configurationFields.description: If required, you can change the binding of the server and Source RCON by changing the Application IP Binding for this instance. NOTE: The IP must be reachable by GSCS, otherwise GSCS's console won't work

configurationFields.label: Server Broadcast IP
configurationFields.description: If needed, sets the IPv4 address of the server shown on the public server list. Useful for players to connect via a different IP, such as through a relay or via DDoS protection

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that may connect to the server at one time. Actual number allowed may be higher as a result of reserved slots for admins (default 20)

configurationFields.label: Reserved Slots
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of reserved slots for admin players, above the player limit

configurationFields.label: Server Admins
configurationFields.description: Server admins can be specified by their Alderon Games IDs under Additional iGameSession Settings. Format is "ServerAdmins=123-456-789" (don't include quotes). One admin per line

configurationFields.label: Maximum Group Slots
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of slots allowed for player groups

configurationFields.label: Allow Paid Users Only
configurationFields.description: If enabled, free-to-play users will not be able to join the server

configurationFields.label: Idle Player Kick Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of time before a player will be automatically disconnected from the server if they are idle/AFK. 0 = idle player kick disabled

configurationFields.label: Maximum Client Ping Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum client ping time before auto-disconnecting a player from the server. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Maximum Client Ping Duration
configurationFields.description: Sets the period that a player's ping time must be above the Maximum Client Ping Time before being disconnected

configurationFields.label: Server Logout Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of time required to be on the logout menu before a player safe logs. 0 = instant logout

configurationFields.label: Allow Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, enables text chat for the entire server

configurationFields.label: Allow Global Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the global chat channel on the server

configurationFields.label: Database Location
configurationFields.description: Sets whether to use a local or remote database. Local is recommended unless connecting shared character data between servers is required

configurationFields.label: Selected Beta Branch
configurationFields.description: Sets which beta branch to install. "Production" is recommended. Use ["Public Test"](https://alderongames.com/public-test-branch-desktop) at your own risk. NOTE: Update the server after switching branches!

configurationFields.label: Discord Server
configurationFields.description: Sets the connected community Discord server. Include only the letters/numbers after the discord.gg part of the server invite link

configurationFields.label: Enable RCON Logging
configurationFields.description: If set, enables RCON logging

configurationFields.label: Failed RCON Login Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the limit on failed RCON login attempts

configurationFields.label: RCON Login Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum time for an RCON login to succeed

configurationFields.label: Maximum RCON Logins Per IP
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum connections to RCON per IP

configurationFields.label: Additional IGameSession Settings
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional settings to include in the [/Script/PathOfTitans.IGameSession] section of Game.ini that are not otherwise set by GSCS. One setting per line.

configurationFields.label: Additional IGameMode Settings
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional settings to include in the [/Script/PathOfTitans.IGameMode] section of Game.ini that are not otherwise set by GSCS. One setting per line.

configurationFields.label: Server Starting Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the in-game time of day the server begins at after a restart. Examples: 100 = 1:00 AM, 1200 = 12:00 PM, and 1800 = 6:00 PM

configurationFields.label: Time Of Day Type
configurationFields.description: Sets whether the server uses a fixed or dynamic time of day

configurationFields.label: Full Day Cycle Length
configurationFields.description: Sets the length of a full day cycle

configurationFields.label: Full Night Cycle Length
configurationFields.description: Sets the length of a full night cycle

configurationFields.label: Total Maximum Characters Per Player
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of characters a player can have in total

configurationFields.label: Species Maximum Characters Per Player
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of characters a player can have per species

configurationFields.label: Allow Fish Spawning
configurationFields.description: If set, enables fish spawning

configurationFields.label: Dinosaur Disabling
configurationFields.description: If desired, all dinosaurs except certain listed dinosaurs can be disabled on the server, by specified the list of allowed dinosaurs in Additional iGameSession Settings as per [these instructions](https://hosting.pathoftitans.wiki/guide/dinosaurs). Format is "AllowedCharacters=DinosaurName" (don't include quotes or + at the beginning). One dinosaur per line

configurationFields.label: Dinosaur Enabling
configurationFields.description: If desired, all dinosaurs except certain listed dinosaurs can be allowed on the server, by specifying the list of disallowed dinosaurs in Additional iGameSession Settings as per [these instructions](https://hosting.pathoftitans.wiki/guide/dinosaurs). Format is "DisallowedCharacters=DinosaurName" (don't include quotes or + at the beginning). One dinosaur per line

configurationFields.label: Enable Water Quality System
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the water quality system

configurationFields.label: Enable Overriding Water Regeneration
configurationFields.description: If set, enables overriding water regeneration. If disabled, the server will use the default values

configurationFields.label: Enable Water Regeneration
configurationFields.description: If enabled, water will naturally regenerate over time. If disabled, you must ensure water restoration quests are on the servermap, otherwise water will eventually run out

configurationFields.label: Water Regeneration Rate Multiplier Update
configurationFields.description: Sets the water regeneration rate multiplier update

configurationFields.label: Water Regeneration Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of time before water applies a regeneration amount. Setting this value too low makes the server update water more frequently and can cause lag

configurationFields.label: Water Regeneration Amount
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of water regenerated every cycle. This scales depending on how large the body of water is

configurationFields.label: Water Regeneration Rain Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets a multiplier that increases the amount of water restored when it rains

configurationFields.label: Enable Waystone Cooldown
configurationFields.description: If set, enables players to spend marks to insta-cooldown Waystones

configurationFields.label: Waystone Cooldown Timer Override
configurationFields.description: Sets the duration of the cooldown timer for Waystones. -1 will use the default cooldown timer

configurationFields.label: Quests Required For Completion
configurationFields.description: Sets how many quests must be completed within a POI before it is "completed"

configurationFields.label: Enable Fall Damage
configurationFields.description: If set, enables fall damage for all users on the server

configurationFields.label: Dead Body Period
configurationFields.description: Sets how long a dead body will persist in the server. 0 = persists forever

configurationFields.label: Respawn Period
configurationFields.description: Sets how long a player must be alive before they can use the '/respawn' command to kill their dinosaur and respawn. Keep relatively high to avoid players piling up corpses on the server and causing issues

configurationFields.label: Enable Home Caves
configurationFields.description: If set, enables home caves on the server

configurationFields.label: Enable Well Rested Buff
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the Well Rested buff

configurationFields.label: Allow Ability Editing In Home Caves Only
configurationFields.description: If set, players can only edit abilities in their home caves. If disabled, players can edit their abilities anywhere so long as they are sleeping. Recommended to be enabled if Home Caves are enabled

configurationFields.label: Allow Hatchling Caves Tutorial
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the tutorial Hatchling Caves. Players will spawn in a tutorial area at 0 growth, and completing quests will bring them to 0.3 growth by the time they exit. If disabled, players will spawn in the world at 0.3 growth and completely skip the tutorial

configurationFields.label: Enable Cave Hunger And Thirst
configurationFields.description: If set, enables hunger and thirst in caves. If disabled, dinosaurs will not lose hunger or thirst in caves and will take no damage if they have no food or water

configurationFields.label: Enable Growth
configurationFields.description: If set, enables growth on the server. If disabled, all dinosaurs will spawn as adults, and all existing characters will be bumped up to adult

configurationFields.label: Additional Passive Growth
configurationFields.description: Adds additional passive growth to all dinosaurs equally. Full growth = 1 so a good value for this might be 0.005, which means a player would take 200 minutes (3.3 hours) to reach adulthood. 0 = passive growth disabled

configurationFields.label: Quest Completion Growth Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Allows the rate of growth earned by players when they complete quests to be adjusted. 0 = growth from quests disabled

configurationFields.label: Quest Completion Marks Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier used when rewarding marks for quest completion

configurationFields.label: Enable Quest Cooldown Timer Override
configurationFields.description: If set, allows the time it takes for a local quest to cooldown after completion to be overridden

configurationFields.label: Quest Cooldown Timer
configurationFields.description: Sets the time it takes for a quest to cooldown before it can be completed again

configurationFields.label: Enable POI Completion Reward Timer Override
configurationFields.description: If set, allows the time it takes for the POI completion reward to reset after reaching 100% to be overriden

configurationFields.label: POI Completion Reward Timer
configurationFields.description: Sets the time it takes for the POI completion reward to reset before it can be completed again

configurationFields.label: Enable Rewards Limit
configurationFields.description: If set, rewards will be limited to the amount set under Rewards Limit

configurationFields.label: Rewards Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum amount of rewards allowed. Requires Enable Rewards Limit to be set

configurationFields.label: Enable Quest Loss On Death
configurationFields.description: If enabled, unclaimed quests will be lost on death

configurationFields.label: Allow Item Collection Within POI Only
configurationFields.description: If set, items must be collected within a POI

configurationFields.label: Allow Growth Loss
configurationFields.description: If set, allows players to lose growth past juvenile/adolescent/sub-adult/adult growth states when they die

configurationFields.label: Marks Loss On Combat Death
configurationFields.description: Sets the percentage of total marks a player will lose when they die from combat

configurationFields.label: Growth Loss On Combat Death
configurationFields.description: Sets the percentage of growth a player will lose when they die from combat

configurationFields.label: Marks Loss On Fall Death
configurationFields.description: Sets the percentage of total marks a player will lose when they die from fall damage

configurationFields.label: Growth Loss On Fall Death
configurationFields.description: Sets the percentage of growth a player will lose when they die from fall damage

configurationFields.label: Marks Loss On Survival Death
configurationFields.description: Sets the percentage of total marks a player will lose when they die from starvation, thirst or drowning

configurationFields.label: Growth Loss On Survival Death
configurationFields.description: Sets the percentage of growth a player will lose when they die from starvation, thirst or drowning

configurationFields.label: Enable Anti-Revenge Kill Lockout
configurationFields.description: If enabled, when a player is killed, any of their other characters within a certain radius are flagged with a 10 minute timer, which prevents those specific characters from logging back in right away. Currently only works with remote databases, for hived servers

configurationFields.label: Anti-Revenge Kill Lockout Radius
configurationFields.description: Sets the radius of the Anti-Revenge Kill Lockout distance

configurationFields.label: Speed Hack Detection Action
configurationFields.description: Sets the action taken when speed hacks are detected. A PlayerHack webhook will also be sent for the log, kick and ban actions

configurationFields.label: Speed Hack Detection Threshold
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of speedhack detections that will be allowed per minute before the Speed Hack Detection Action is taken. Helps to minimise false positives due to packet loss or lag. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Restrict Carnivore Grouping
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will restrict carnivore grouping to the same species

configurationFields.label: Restrict Herbivore Grouping
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will restrict herbivore grouping to the same species

configurationFields.label: Group Communication Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the distance for players to be able to see their other group members

configurationFields.label: Enable Perma Death
configurationFields.description: If set, activates permanent death on the server. Deceased characters will show up as corpses on the Character Selection Menu

configurationFields.label: Enable Death Info
configurationFields.description: If set, displays a textbox on the Character Select Screen that provides info about a dead character when Perma Death is enabled
